integrity: The proposition has an analytical proof; the 13,770 and 216 executed finite numerical checks are diagnostics, not substitutes for an infinite proof. Current literature comparisons have explicitly stated coverage and remaining risk.
scientific_limitations: Fixed dimension, uniform angular distribution and genuine regularly varying boundary tail are required. No nonasymptotic rate, closed-form limiting center density, extension to oscillatory two-sided power tails, or claim of global historical priority.
title: Joint Poisson-center limits and full-simplex support for random smallest enclosing balls
